`enum ShaderFeature`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderFeature.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/ShaderFeature.java)

A GLSL feature that only some dialects accept, with the first desktop and ES versions that have it and the pattern that finds it in a source.

## Description

[`ShaderSource`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/) finds the features of each stage.
[`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/) refuses a stage that uses a feature its [`GlslDialect`](/reference/pipeline/glsldialect/) lacks, and in dev mode the constructor of [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/) warns once about each feature beyond GLSL 1.20, since such a shader does not compile on every backend.

## Learn more

- [Pick a dialect](/build/shader-translation/#pick-a-dialect)

<a id="ShaderFeature-method-find"></a>

### find

`Set<ShaderFeature> find(CharSequence code)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the features that a piece of GLSL code uses.
The code is searched as it is: strip the comments first, or a word in a comment counts.
